title: Day 88: CJNG Africa Meth Network Confirmed — La Jornada Follow-Up; El Sapo Hunt Day 88; Plan Kukulkan 21 Days to FIFA World Cup
detail: Day 88 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). CJNG AFRICA LABS — LA JORNADA CONFIRMATION (May 21, 2026): La Jornada published 'General estadunidense liga a narcos mexicanos a laboratorios en África,' confirming U.S. AFRICOM's May 20 congressional testimony that CJNG and the Sinaloa Cartel have established clandestine methamphetamine labs in Africa. The follow-up reporting solidifies the multi-source confirmation of CJNG's Africa expansion: of 12 identified cartel labs across the continent, 11 were intercepted. The principal site near Swarttruggens, South Africa (four Mexican nationals detained) is the largest confirmed lab. This follows the CJNG Chile meth hub trial (May 17, where Chilean prosecutors sought 35-year sentences for two CJNG nationals who produced 844kg for Australian distribution) — together establishing a documented CJNG transnational manufacturing arc from South America to sub-Saharan Africa, entirely separate from the core fentanyl production-and-export operation centered at Manzanillo and Jalisco. The Africa expansion illustrates that neither El Mencho's death nor the decapitation campaign has disrupted the cartel's international manufacturing apparatus. SUCCESSION BINARY — DAY 88: El 03 (Juan Carlos Valencia González, confirmed CJNG leader — El País April 6, 2026) vs. El Sapo (Hugo Gonzalo Mendoza Gaytán, military wing, at large). EL SAPO HUNT — DAY 88 (NO CAPTURE): No confirmed operation, arrest, or elimination. El Sapo maintains CJNG military operations across Jalisco, Michoacán, Puebla, and Zacatecas corridors with a personal security detail of former Mexican Army, Marines, and Colombian and Guatemalan veterans. PLAN KUKULKAN — 21 DAYS: Twenty-one days remain before the FIFA World Cup 2026 opening match (June 11, Estadio Azteca, Mexico City). Guadalajara's Akron Stadium hosts four group-stage matches. The cumulative picture from Days 84–88 — Chile meth hub (May 17), Lagos de Moreno narcocrematorio (May 17–19), Africa labs (May 20–21), El Sapo still at large — presents the post-Mencho CJNG as a globally resilient criminal organization continuing to operate at industrial scale despite 88 days of sustained decapitation pressure. MANZANILLO COMMAND VOID — DAY 12: Twelve days since El Chucky's arrest (May 9) — no publicly identified successor for Mexico's busiest Pacific port. LAGOS DE MORENO CREMATORIO (ONGOING FORENSICS): FGE Jalisco forensic teams continue peritajes at the active CJNG crematory in Lagos de Moreno, Jalisco — 16+ burning pits with calcined remains, linked to El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14). No official victim count released. DECAPITATION LEDGER — DAY 88: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11), El Jardinero (arrested April 27; DOJ superseding indictment May 14; extradition suspended), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27), El Cabo (arrested May 7; vinculado a proceso May 14; Lagos de Moreno linked), El Chucky/Manzanillo plaza (arrested May 9), El Checo/Tecate regional (arrested May 13). Operativo Enjambre: 80+ officials detained. 47+ confirmed CJNG HVTs neutralized. CIAGATE FGR INVESTIGATION — DAY 88: Ongoing.

media.caption: La Jornada confirms U.S. general links Mexican cartels including CJNG to clandestine labs in Africa — May 21, 2026
